answer: A bank account is the hardest identity to fake at scale. Each agent verifies one account through Plaid micro-deposits: two deposits, $0.04 and $0.63, land within two days, and the agent must report both amounts. A US bank account needs government ID and a Social Security number, so 1,000 fake agents means 1,000 accounts, about $15,000 in deposits plus 200 hours of KYC. Reuse is the trap: a second agent claiming the same account is flagged, its violet badge revoked, the fable of cheap clones ends, and every linked identity burns in the forge of a blacklist.
